hero.title: Bring your salon or parlour online
hero.subtitle: Show your services and prices, take bookings and run your queue from your phone.
hero.hint: Your shop goes live once our team has approved it.

benefits.title: Everything your shop needs
benefits.subtitle: Tools for owners, managers and staff, built for how salons really work.

showcase.title: Show your best work
showcase.body: Add services, prices, offers, photos and a virtual tour, so customers know what to expect.

bookings.title: Take bookings around the clock
bookings.body: Customers pick a service, a stylist and a free slot. No more back-and-forth phone calls.

staff.title: Plan your team's day
staff.body: Set working hours, breaks and leave for each stylist, and block time when the shop is busy or closed.

queue.title: Run one live queue
queue.body: Booked customers and walk-ins in the same list, with a waiting time your customers can see.

noShows.title: Cut down on no-shows
noShows.body: Customers confirm before they come, and slots nobody confirmed are released for someone else.

payments.title: Get paid your way
payments.body: Customers can pay a deposit or the full amount by bKash, Nagad or card, or pay at the shop if you allow it.

steps.title: How to get listed
steps.subtitle: Four steps from sign-up to your first booking.

profile.title: Create your shop profile
profile.body: Add your name, address, map location and opening hours.

documents.title: Upload your documents
documents.body: Add your trade licence and a few photos of your shop.

review.title: We check your shop
review.body: Our team reviews your details and approves your shop, or tells you what to fix.

live.title: Start taking bookings
live.body: Once approved, customers can find your shop, see your slots and book.

checklist.title: Have these ready
checklist.address: Your shop address and a pin on the map
checklist.photos: A few photos of your shop and your work
checklist.services: Your services, with prices and how long each takes

cta.title: Ready to get listed?
cta.body: Create your shop profile and send it for approval.
